An HN post hit 99 points arguing companies cutting headcount for AI will lose to ones who didn't. OpenAI is piloting ChatGPT ads into financial services. The Felix outbound story is fully loaded. Google Health Coach is on Day 4 of launch. Zero Gutted response. Every hour is a missed search capture — but the window is not closed. Platform launches create category validation. Google just told the world AI health coaching is a real category. Gutted gets to ride that wave with a specialist positioning that a generalist platform cannot match. The response takes 90 minutes to draft and deploy. Monitoring is back. Phase 1 monitoring RESTORED on May 19 — a genuine infrastructure win. The OS can see itself again. The Standards Registry expanded 124 to 167 rules. These are real deliverables in a week where the system also absorbed the most significant external market signal of the year. The 78-day zero-revenue streak is not a crisis. It is a diagnostic: the intelligence engine is operating at analyst-firm quality, every venture pipeline is stacked with qualified opportunities, and the only conversion gap is decision throughput — approvals, toggles, and the 30-minute infrastructure fixes that unlock months of stalled output.
